desc: Available Razor-Sharp and full Triple-Point Serrated with pointed tip, plus Triple-Point Serrated with tear drop tip for fast cutting without danger of point penetration. Blades are full tang, taper ground AUS 6M stainless steel with a fine bead blast finish. Friction grooves are placed on the blade spine, choil and near the tip for maximum blade control and safety. The contoured Zytel handle fits the hand neatly.
